points.description: States that push is one of the two main stack functions (operation that adds/inserts an element onto the top of the stack).
States that pop is the other main stack function (operation that removes an element from the top of the stack).

rubric.notes: Full marks only if both named functions, push and pop, are given using these exact terms. Each function is worth its own half; naming only one earns that half only. Vague descriptions without the terms (e.g. "add and remove", "insert and delete") earn nothing, and a wrong extra function (e.g. peek, top, enqueue, dequeue) listed as a main function costs the whole answer's affected point.
